description: This file defines functions for creating and initializing SNApplication instances with various configurations, including options for different crypto implementations and environment setups.

methods.name: createApplicationWithOptions({ identifier, environment, platform, host, crypto, device })

methods.name: createApplication(identifier, environment, platform, host, crypto)
methods.description: Creates an SNApplication instance with default options, forwarding parameters to createApplicationWithOptions.

methods.name: createApplicationWithFakeCrypto(identifier, environment, platform, host)
methods.description: Creates an Application instance using FakeWebCrypto for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: createApplicationWithRealCrypto(identifier, environment, platform, host)
methods.description: Creates an Application instance using real SNWebCrypto for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: createAppWithRandNamespace(environment, platform)
methods.description: Creates an application with a randomly generated namespace identifier.

methods.name: createInitAppWithFakeCrypto(environment, platform)
methods.description: Creates and initializes an application with a fake crypto setup.

methods.name: createInitAppWithRealCrypto(environment, platform)
methods.description: Creates and initializes an application with a real crypto setup.

methods.name: createAndInitializeApplication(namespace, environment, platform, host, crypto)
methods.description: Creates an application and performs necessary initialization steps before returning it.

methods.name: initializeApplication(application)
methods.description: Performs preparation and launch procedures for the given application instance.
